# Sample PDF/OCR Fixture

`sample-document.pdf` and `sample-document.ocr.json` are generated by `npm run fixtures:generate` from the same deterministic field source in `scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs`.

The PDF uses a 595 x 842 point page. The OCR JSON treats the same page as a 595 x 842 pixel source coordinate plane with a top-left origin. If the PDF generation code positions text with PDF's bottom-left origin, the generator converts it by using `topY = sourcePageHeight - pdfY - textHeight`.

Tests can verify alignment by loading the OCR JSON and asserting that every mappable field references an existing PDF page and has a bbox inside that page's source dimensions. `npm run fixtures:check` fails when committed fixture output no longer matches the deterministic generator.
